chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: Saturday-night brawls, Tiger Rag and the burning palm trees
summary: Stockyard factions fight every Saturday and the band plays Tiger Rag until the police come; one night the palm trees burn.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Oh, God -- thousands of them--- Well, anyway, I could remember one funny incident that - you know, the stock yards was close to that place where we were - you know - and---
If the wind is in the right way - you could smell them---

Yeah - well, anyway, there used to be two factions . come in there on Saturday night - I guess the cutters and the killers or whatever the hell they were -- and they would sit on opposite sides of the room. And, we knew - just as sure as they came - and they came every Saturday -- there would be a big fight and we had a thing going that if the fight started, we were to play "Tiger Rag" - stand up and play "Tiger Rag" as long as we could and every Saturday we stood up and played "Tiger Rag" until the police came. And, I mean - some bloody fights - I'm talking about - these bruisers -- and I remember one fight on one Saturday night -- I'll never forget this -- somebody set fire to all those palm trees---
Those palm trees were burning and the players were playing 'Tiger Rag' and Chinamen were flying through the air---
That must have been a wild scene--
Yeah - yeah. And, uh, well, it was a wonderful place -- it was really a wonderful---
You don't play 'Tiger Rag' much anymore do you---
God no - I hope not. I always think of those fighting days--- but, anyway, I got some lovely experience with that band and we stayed there a long time and a lot of things---
By a long time - do you mean like two months - something like that---
Oh, I think it was even more than that---
Yeah -- well, we went back there again--- because I remember we worked with a band -- we went in a couple of ballrooms in Chicago - not the big ones---
You went into a rendezvous pretty quick too---
Yeah - but that's a little later - we did a few things around Chicago - then we went back-- and I think the last time we worked was for a, Tom Wing was his name --
Tom Wing was the Chinese man .
